_comment: Hub population spots (aliveness_wow.md Top 12 #11). Each spot is a cozy resting place around the fort's exterior -- window-sill-height nooks along the blanket walls, the flanks of the two walkable cushions, and the shoulders of each world's own door -- authored to keep the fort mouth (BrambleDoor's approach south of the fort), every door's own trigger box, and Callie's cushion fully clear (worlds/pillow_fort/pillow_fort.gd's own dressing-prop comment: 'None of these props carry collision ... so they cannot physically block anything', but FortResident placement still keeps a real visual gap so nothing reads as cluttering a walked route). 'world' is the preferred group (worlds/pillow_fort/pillow_fort.gd's per-world door tint: bramble=umber, marmalade=orange, wisp=silver-blue, tortoise=moss-green) -- overflow beyond a group's own returned-dream count is filled from any spot still free, per _build_fort_residents()'s assignment order. The 8 tortoise-tagged spots (M4) sit north of the fort near TortoiseDoor (0,0,9.2), clear of its own trigger box and the fence ring -- FORT_RESIDENT_CAP stays 30 (unchanged, out of this pass's one-door-only territory), so a fourth fully-completed world will not get every dream a visible resident; a documented, honest limitation, not a bug.
